then /bin/sh \"${HOME-}/.orca/agent-hooks/claude-hook.sh\"; else { command -p cat 2>/dev/null || cat; } >/dev/null 2>&1 || :; printf '{}\\n'; fi ;; esac; fi","durationMs":45},"type":"attachment","uuid":"e2d1025a-fe48-4ac2-83e5-e82a0e8d1b3f","timestamp":"2026-10-13T14:28:35.851Z","session_id":"a121db57-1bee-4dbb-8856-8744e70c4142","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/maysg/orca/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"91f90b48-e4a0-44e0-aa4c-47594fc96da9","version":"2.1.296","gitBranch":"main"}
{"parentUuid":"a1cfa5b2-b0a4-45c2-aa15-4a2d345a832f","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"b166393f-ae29-48ab-a7bb-82b437a312be","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01EzGGNNRpcNCKJ4Rr6zRV1J","type":"tool_result","content":"\"\"\"Updates and pages: the two kinds of content (see CONTEXT.md).\n\nBoth have the same fields and rules: a title, a slug, a Markdown body, a status\n(draft or published), an author, and created and updated timestamps. Pages add\na nav order. New content is always a draft.\n\nA slug is made from the title on first save and changes only when the admin\nasks. Slugs are unique across updates and pages together, because both are\nfiles in the same exported site; \"index\" is reserved for the home page.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nimport sqlite3\nimport unicodedata\nfrom datetime import datetime, timezone\n\nfrom app import db\n\n\nclass InvalidContent(ValueError):\n    \"\"\"The form cannot be saved; the message is shown to the user.\"\"\"\n\n\nTABLES = (\"posts\", \"pages\")\nRESERVED_SLUGS = {\"index\"}\n\n\ndef slugify(text: str) -> str:\n    # Strip accents (é -> e); any other non-ASCII character separates words.\n    plain = \"\".join(c for c in unicodedata.normalize(\"NFKD\", text)\n                    if not unicodedata.combining(c))\n    return re.sub(r\"[^a-z0-9]+\", \"-\", plain.lower()).strip(\"-\")\n\n\ndef _unique_slug(conn: sqlite3.Connection, text: str, fallback: str,\n                 keep: str | None = None) -> str:\n    \"\"\"A free slug for `text`. `keep` is the item's own current slug, not a clash.\"\"\"\n    base = slugify(text) or fallback\n    taken = set(RESERVED_SLUGS)\n    for table in TABLES:\n        taken |= {row[\"slug\"] for row in conn.execute(\n            f\"SELECT slug FROM {table} WHERE slug = ? OR slug LIKE ?\", (base, f\"{base}-%\"))}\n    taken.discard(keep)\n    slug, n = base, 2\n    while slug in taken:\n        slug, n = f\"{base}-{n}\", n + 1\n    return slug\n\n\ndef _now() -> str:\n    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec=\"seconds\")\n\n\ndef _clean_title(title: str) -> str:\n    title = title.strip()\n    if not title:\n        raise InvalidContent(\"The title cannot be empty.\")\n    return title\n\n\ndef parse_nav_order(value: str) -> int:\n    try:\n        return int(value.strip())\n    except ValueError:\n        raise InvalidContent(\"Nav order must be a whole number, like 10.\") from None\n\n\nclass Store:\n    \"\"\"One kind of content, kept in its own table.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, table: str, noun: str, plural: str, *, published_order: str,\n                 has_nav_order: bool = False):\n        self.table, self.noun, self.plural = table, noun, plural\n        self.has_nav_order = has_nav_order\n        self._published_order = published_order\n        nav = f\"{table}.nav_order, \" if has_nav_order else \"\"\n        self._select = (\n            f\"SELECT {table}.id, title, slug, body, status, {table}.created_at, updated_at, \"\n            f\"{nav}{table}.author_id, users.name AS author \"\n            f\"FROM {table} JOIN users ON users.id = {table}.author_id\"\n        )\n\n    def create(self, title: str, body: str, author_id: int,\n               nav_order: int | None = None) -> int:\n        title = _clean_title(title)\n        now = _now()\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            columns = [\"title\", \"slug\", \"body\", \"status\", \"author_id\", \"created_at\", \"updated_at\"]\n            values = [title, _unique_slug(conn, title, self.noun), body, \"draft\",\n                      author_id, now, now]\n            if self.has_nav_order:\n                if nav_order is None:  # a new page goes to the end of the menu\n                    nav_order = conn.execute(\n                        f\"SELECT COALESCE(MAX(nav_order), 0) + 1 FROM {self.table}\").fetchone()[0]\n                columns.append(\"nav_order\")\n                values.append(nav_order)\n            cursor = conn.execute(\n                f\"INSERT INTO {self.table} ({', '.join(columns)}) \"\n                f\"VALUES ({', '.join('?' * len(values))})\", values)\n            return cursor.lastrowid\n\n    def edit(self, item_id: int, title: str, body: str, *, slug: str | None = None,\n             nav_order: int | None = None) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Save an edit. A new slug is made URL-safe and unique; None or blank\n        keeps the current one.\"\"\"\n        title = _clean_title(title)\n        changes = {\"title\": title, \"body\": body, \"updated_at\": _now()}\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            if slug is not None:\n                current = conn.execute(f\"SELECT slug FROM {self.table} WHERE id = ?\",\n                                       (item_id,)).fetchone()\n                if slug.strip() and not slugify(slug):\n                    raise InvalidContent(\"A slug needs at least one letter or number.\")\n                if current and slugify(slug) not in (\"\", current[\"slug\"]):\n                    changes[\"slug\"] = _unique_slug(conn, slug, self.noun, keep=current[\"slug\"])\n            if nav_order is not None and self.has_nav_order:\n                changes[\"nav_order\"] = nav_order\n            conn.execute(\n                f\"UPDATE {self.table} SET {', '.join(f'{k} = ?' for k in changes)} WHERE id = ?\",\n                (*changes.values(), item_id))\n\n    def publish(self, item_id: int) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Mark published. Going live counts as an update, so fans see a fresh date.\"\"\"\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            conn.execute(f\"UPDATE {self.table} SET status = 'published', updated_at = ? \"\n                         \"WHERE id = ?\", (_now(), item_id))\n\n    def unpublish(self, item_id: int) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Back to draft. The next `cms publish` removes it from the site.\"\"\"\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            conn.execute(f\"UPDATE {self.table} SET status = 'draft' WHERE id = ?\", (item_id,))\n\n    def delete(self, item_id: int) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Gone for good. If it was published, the next `cms publish` removes it.\"\"\"\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            conn.execute(f\"DELETE FROM {self.table} WHERE id = ?\", (item_id,))\n\n    def get(self, item_id: int) -> sqlite3.Row | None:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            return conn.execute(f\"{self._select} WHERE {self.table}.id = ?\",\n                                (item_id,)).fetchone()\n\n    def list_all(self) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            return conn.execute(f\"{self._select} \"\n                                f\"ORDER BY updated_at DESC, {self.table}.id DESC\").fetchall()\n\n    def list_published(self) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n        \"\"\"What `cms publish` exports, in the order the public site shows it.\"\"\"\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            return conn.execute(f\"{self._select} WHERE status = 'published' \"\n                                f\"ORDER BY {self._published_order}\").fetchall()\n\n\n# The home page orders updates by when they were first written, not updated_at,\n# so a correction never jumps above a newer update (CONTEXT.md, Decisions).\nUPDATES = Store(\"posts\", \"update\", \"updates\",\n                published_order=\"posts.created_at DESC, posts.id DESC\")\nPAGES = Store(\"pages\", \"page\", \"pages\", has_nav_order=True,\n              published_order=\"pages.nav_order, pages.title, pages.id\")\n\"\"\"Write, edit, publish, unpublish, and delete updates and pages.\n\ncontent_router(store) builds the same routes for each kind of content, so\npages follow exactly the rules updates do. Every route requires a signed-in\nuser; publish and unpublish require the admin, and editing or deleting is\nchecked against app/permissions.py. Only the admin may change a slug or set a\npage's nav order.\n\nThe editor form has two buttons: Save stores the item, Preview re-renders the\nform with the sanitized Markdown and stores nothing. Publishing only marks the\nitem; it reaches the public site at the next `cms publish` and `cms deploy`.\n\nCSRF is a parameter after `user` (not `dependencies=[...]`, which FastAPI runs\nfirst) so an anonymous POST is sent to login rather than refused with 403.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Form, HTTPException, Request\nfrom fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse\n\nfrom app import auth, markdown, permissions\nfrom app.content import InvalidContent, Store, parse_nav_order\nfrom app.templating import flash, templates\n\n\ndef content_router(store: Store) -> APIRouter:\n    prefix = f\"/admin/{store.plural}\"\n    noun = store.noun\n    router = APIRouter(prefix=prefix)\n\n    def editor_page(request: Request, user, *, item=None, title: str = \"\", body: str = \"\",\n                    slug: str | None = None, nav_order: str | None = None,\n                    error: str = \"\", status: int = 200):\n        may_edit = item is None or permissions.may_edit(user, item)\n        if nav_order is None and item is not None and store.has_nav_order:\n            nav_order = str(item[\"nav_order\"])\n        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n            request, \"admin/content_edit.html\",\n            {\"title\": f\"Edit {noun}\" if item else f\"New {noun}\", \"user\": user,\n             \"kind\": store, \"item\": item,\n             \"action\": f\"{prefix}/{item['id']}\" if item else prefix,\n             \"form_title\": title, \"body\": body,\n             \"slug\": item[\"slug\"] if slug is None and item else slug or \"\",\n             \"nav_order\": nav_order or \"\",\n             \"preview\": markdown.render(body), \"error\": error,\n             \"may_delete\": item is not None and permissions.may_delete(user, item),\n             \"refused_reason\": \"\" if may_edit else permissions.PUBLISHED_IS_ADMIN_ONLY},\n            status_code=status,\n        )\n\n    def get_or_404(item_id: int):\n        item = store.get(item_id)\n        if item is None:\n            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=f\"No such {noun}\")\n        return item\n\n    def admin_fields(user, item, slug: str | None, nav_order: str | None):\n        \"\"\"Check and parse the admin-only fields; None means leave unchanged.\"\"\"\n        if not store.has_nav_order:\n            nav_order = None\n        permissions.check_admin_fields(user, item, slug=slug, nav_order=nav_order)\n        if not permissions.is_admin(user):\n            return None, None\n        parsed = parse_nav_order(nav_order) if nav_order and nav_order.strip() else None\n        return slug, parsed\n\n    @router.get(\"\", name=f\"list_{store.plural}\")\n    def list_items(request: Request, user=auth.SIGNED_IN):\n        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n            request, \"admin/content_list.html\",\n            {\"title\": store.plural.capitalize(), \"user\": user, \"kind\": store,\n             \"items\": store.list_all()},\n        )\n\n    @router.get(\"/new\", name=f\"new_{noun}\")\n    def new_item(request: Request, user=auth.SIGNED_IN):\n        return editor_page(request, user)\n\n    @router.post(\"\", name=f\"create_{noun}\")\n    def create_item(request: Request, user=auth.SIGNED_IN, _csrf=auth.CSRF,\n                    title: str = Form(\"\"), body: str = Form(\"\"),\n                    nav_order: str | None = Form(None), action: str = Form(\"save\")):\n        if action == \"preview\":\n            return editor_page(request, user, title=title, body=body, nav_order=nav_order)\n        try:\n            _, order = admin_fields(user, None, None, nav_order)\n            item_id = store.create(title, body, user[\"id\"], nav_order=order)\n        except InvalidContent as exc:\n            return editor_page(request, user, title=title, body=body, nav_order=nav_order,\n                               error=str(exc), status=400)\n        flash(request, \"success\", \"Draft saved.\")\n        return RedirectResponse(f\"{prefix}/{item_id}\", status_code=303)\n\n    @router.get(\"/{item_id}\", name=f\"show_{noun}\")\n    def show_item(request: Request, item_id: int, user=auth.SIGNED_IN):\n        item = get_or_404(item_id)\n        return editor_page(request, user, item=item, title=item[\"title\"], body=item[\"body\"])\n\n    @router.post(\"/{item_id}\", name=f\"save_{noun}\")\n    def save_item(request: Request, item_id: int, user=auth.SIGNED_IN, _csrf=auth.CSRF,\n                  title: str = Form(\"\"), body: str = Form(\"\"), slug: str | None = Form(None),\n                  nav_order: str | None = Form(None), action: str = Form(\"save\")):\n        item = get_or_404(item_id)\n        permissions.check_edit(user, item)\n        form = {\"title\": title, \"body\": body, \"slug\": slug, \"nav_order\": nav_order}\n        if action == \"preview\":\n            return editor_page(request, user, item=item, **form)\n        try:\n            new_slug, order = admin_fields(user, item, slug, nav_order)\n            store.edit(item_id, title, body, slug=new_slug, nav_order=order)\n        except InvalidContent as exc:\n            return editor_page(request, user, item=item, **form, error=str(exc), status=400)\n        flash(request, \"success\", \"Changes saved.\")\n        return RedirectResponse(f\"{prefix}/{item_id}\", status_code=303)\n\n    def change_status(request: Request, item_id: int, change, message: str):\n        get_or_404(item_id)\n        change(item_id)\n        flash(request, \"success\", message)\n        return RedirectResponse(f\"{prefix}/{item_id}\", status_code=303)\n\n    @router.post(\"/{item_id}/publish\", name=f\"publish_{noun}\")\n    def publish_item(request: Request, item_id: int, user=auth.ADMIN, _csrf=auth.CSRF):\n        return change_status(request, item_id, store.publish,\n                             \"Published. Run cms publish and cms deploy to put it live.\")\n\n    @router.post(\"/{item_id}/unpublish\", name=f\"unpublish_{noun}\")\n    def unpublish_item(request: Request, item_id: int, user=auth.ADMIN, _csrf=auth.CSRF):\n        return change_status(request, item_id, store.unpublish,\n                             \"Unpublished. Run cms publish and cms deploy to take it down.\")\n\n    @router.get(\"/{item_id}/delete\", name=f\"confirm_delete_{noun}\")\n    def confirm_delete(request: Request, item_id: int, user=auth.SIGNED_IN):\n        item = get_or_404(item_id)\n        permissions.check_delete(user, item)\n        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n            request, \"admin/content_delete.html\",\n            {\"title\": f\"Delete {noun}\", \"user\": user, \"kind\": store, \"item\": item},\n        )\n\n    @router.post(\"/{item_id}/delete\", name=f\"delete_{noun}\")\n    def delete_item(request: Request, item_id: int, user=auth.SIGNED_IN, _csrf=auth.CSRF):\n        item = get_or_404(item_id)\n        permissions.check_delete(user, item)\n        store.delete(item_id)\n        if item[\"status\"] == \"published\":\n            flash(request, \"success\", f\"Deleted “{item['title']}”. \"\n                                      \"Run cms publish and cms deploy to take it down.\")\n        else:\n            flash(request, \"success\", f\"Deleted the draft “{item['title']}”.\")\n        return RedirectResponse(prefix, status_code=303)\n\n    return router\n\"\"\"The admin console home. Every route here requires a signed-in user.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Request\n\nfrom app import auth\nfrom app.templating import templates\n\nrouter = APIRouter()\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin\")\ndef admin_home(request: Request, user=auth.SIGNED_IN):\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/hello.html\", {\"title\": \"Admin\", \"user\": user},\n    )\n\"\"\"The FastAPI application.\n\nThe admin console answers at /admin (behind login) and the public preview at /.\nRoutes live in their own modules under app/routes/ and are included here. Keep\nthis file small.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import FastAPI, Request\nfrom fastapi.responses import HTMLResponse, RedirectResponse\nfrom starlette.middleware.sessions import SessionMiddleware\n\nfrom app import auth, settings\nfrom app.publish import render_home\nfrom app.content import PAGES, UPDATES\nfrom app.routes import admin, login\nfrom app.routes.content import content_router\nfrom app.templating import templates\n\n\ndef create_app() -> FastAPI:\n    app = FastAPI(title=\"IPHS 400 MP2 CMS\")\n    app.add_middleware(SessionMiddleware, secret_key=settings.SECRET_KEY,\n                       session_cookie=\"cms_session\", same_site=\"strict\")\n\n    @app.exception_handler(auth.LoginRequired)\n    def send_to_login(request: Request, exc: auth.LoginRequired):\n        return RedirectResponse(\"/login\", status_code=303)\n\n    @app.exception_handler(auth.Refused)\n    def refused_screen(request: Request, exc: auth.Refused):\n        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n            request, \"admin/refused.html\",\n            {\"title\": \"Not allowed\", \"reason\": exc.detail,\n             \"user\": auth.signed_in_user(request)},\n            status_code=403,\n        )\n\n    app.include_router(login.router)\n    app.include_router(admin.router)\n    app.include_router(content_router(UPDATES))\n    app.include_router(content_router(PAGES))\n\n    @app.get(\"/\", response_class=HTMLResponse)\n    def public_home():\n        # A quick look at the home page. The full site, with its stylesheet\n        # and update pages, is what `cms publish` writes to site/.\n        return render_home()\n\n    return app\n\n\napp = create_app()\n\"\"\"SQLite access. Every call opens a short-lived connection to the current\nsettings.DATABASE_PATH, so tests can point it at a temporary file.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\nfrom contextlib import contextmanager\nfrom collections.abc import Iterator\n\nfrom app import settings\n\nSCHEMA = \"\"\"\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (\n    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    email         TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE,\n    name          TEXT NOT NULL,\n    password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,\n    role          TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('admin', 'editor')),\n    active        INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,\n    created_at    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- An Update is stored as a post (see CONTEXT.md).\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS posts (\n    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    title      TEXT NOT NULL,\n    slug       TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,\n    body       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    status     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft' CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'published')),\n    author_id  INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id),\n    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,\n    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL\n);\n\n-- A Page: the same fields as an update, plus its place in the public menu.\n-- Slugs are unique across posts and pages together (app/content.py).\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pages (\n    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    title      TEXT NOT NULL,\n    slug       TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,\n    body       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    status     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft' CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'published')),\n    nav_order  INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    author_id  INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id),\n    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,\n    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL\n);\n\"\"\"\n\n\n@contextmanager\ndef connect() -> Iterator[sqlite3.Connection]:\n    \"\"\"Yield a connection with the schema in place; commit on success.\"\"\"\n    conn = sqlite3.connect(settings.DATABASE_PATH)\n    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row\n    try:\n        conn.executescript(SCHEMA)\n        yield conn\n        conn.commit()\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\"\"\"The Jinja environment shared by the admin console routes.\n\nEvery admin template gets `csrf_token`, so each state-changing form can carry\nit without each route passing it by hand, and `flash`, the one-time message a\nroute left with flash() before redirecting.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import Request\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\n\nfrom app import auth, settings\n\n\ndef flash(request: Request, kind: str, text: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Leave a message (\"success\" or \"error\") for the next page rendered.\"\"\"\n    request.session[\"flash\"] = {\"kind\": kind, \"text\": text}\n\n\ndef _csrf(request: Request) -> dict[str, str]:\n    return {\"csrf_token\": auth.csrf_token(request)}\n\n\ndef _flash(request: Request) -> dict[str, dict | None]:\n    return {\"flash\": request.session.pop(\"flash\", None)}\n\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES),\n                            context_processors=[_csrf, _flash])\n\"\"\"Sessions, CSRF tokens, and the signed-in user.\n\nThe session lives in a signed cookie (Starlette's SessionMiddleware). It holds\nonly the user id and the CSRF token, never a password.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport hmac\nimport secrets\nimport sqlite3\n\nfrom fastapi import Depends, HTTPException, Request\n\nfrom app import users\n\n\nclass LoginRequired(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised for an anonymous visitor; main.py turns it into a redirect.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass Refused(HTTPException):\n    \"\"\"A signed-in user tried something their role does not allow. main.py\n    shows the \"not allowed\" screen with this reason, as a 403.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, reason: str):\n        super().__init__(status_code=403, detail=reason)\n\n\ndef csrf_token(request: Request) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Return this session's CSRF token, creating one if needed.\"\"\"\n    token = request.session.get(\"csrf_token\")\n    if not token:\n        token = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)\n        request.session[\"csrf_token\"] = token\n    return token\n\n\nasync def check_csrf(request: Request) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Dependency for every state-changing route: reject a missing or wrong token.\"\"\"\n    form = await request.form()\n    sent = form.get(\"csrf_token\")\n    expected = request.session.get(\"csrf_token\")\n    if not (isinstance(sent, str) and expected\n            and hmac.compare_digest(sent, expected)):\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail=\"Invalid or missing CSRF token\")\n\n\ndef signed_in_user(request: Request) -> sqlite3.Row | None:\n    \"\"\"The signed-in, still-active user, or None.\"\"\"\n    user_id = request.session.get(\"user_id\")\n    return users.get_active_user(user_id) if user_id else None\n\n\ndef current_user(request: Request) -> sqlite3.Row:\n    \"\"\"Dependency for every admin screen: the signed-in, still-active user.\"\"\"\n    user = signed_in_user(request)\n    if user is None:\n        request.session.pop(\"user_id\", None)\n        raise LoginRequired\n    return user\n\n\ndef admin_user(user: sqlite3.Row = Depends(current_user)) -> sqlite3.Row:\n    \"\"\"Dependency for admin-only actions: an editor is refused with 403.\"\"\"\n    if user[\"role\"] != \"admin\":\n        raise Refused(\"Only the admin can do this.\")\n    return user\n\n\ndef start_session(request: Request, user: sqlite3.Row) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Begin a fresh session for the user, with a new CSRF token.\"\"\"\n    request.session.clear()\n    request.session[\"user_id\"] = user[\"id\"]\n    csrf_token(request)\n\n\ndef end_session(request: Request) -> None:\n    request.session.clear()\n\n\nCSRF = Depends(check_csrf)\nSIGNED_IN = Depends(current_user)\nADMIN = Depends(admin_user)","is_error":false}]},"uuid":"004891c4-33b8-458b-8778-593ba14193e9","timestamp":"2026-10-13T14:28:36.282Z","toolUseResult":{"stdout":"\"\"\"Updates and pages: the two kinds of content (see CONTEXT.md).\n\nBoth have the same fields and rules: a title, a slug, a Markdown body, a status\n(draft or published), an author, and created and updated timestamps. Pages add\na nav order. New content is always a draft.\n\nA slug is made from the title on first save and changes only when the admin\nasks. Slugs are unique across updates and pages together, because both are\nfiles in the same exported site; \"index\" is reserved for the home page.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nimport sqlite3\nimport unicodedata\nfrom datetime import datetime, timezone\n\nfrom app import db\n\n\nclass InvalidContent(ValueError):\n    \"\"\"The form cannot be saved; the message is shown to the user.\"\"\"\n\n\nTABLES = (\"posts\", \"pages\")\nRESERVED_SLUGS = {\"index\"}\n\n\ndef slugify(text: str) -> str:\n    # Strip accents (é -> e); any other non-ASCII character separates words.\n    plain = \"\".join(c for c in unicodedata.normalize(\"NFKD\", text)\n                    if not unicodedata.combining(c))\n    return re.sub(r\"[^a-z0-9]+\", \"-\", plain.lower()).strip(\"-\")\n\n\ndef _unique_slug(conn: sqlite3.Connection, text: str, fallback: str,\n                 keep: str | None = None) -> str:\n    \"\"\"A free slug for `text`. `keep` is the item's own current slug, not a clash.\"\"\"\n    base = slugify(text) or fallback\n    taken = set(RESERVED_SLUGS)\n    for table in TABLES:\n        taken |= {row[\"slug\"] for row in conn.execute(\n            f\"SELECT slug FROM {table} WHERE slug = ? OR slug LIKE ?\", (base, f\"{base}-%\"))}\n    taken.discard(keep)\n    slug, n = base, 2\n    while slug in taken:\n        slug, n = f\"{base}-{n}\", n + 1\n    return slug\n\n\ndef _now() -> str:\n    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec=\"seconds\")\n\n\ndef _clean_title(title: str) -> str:\n    title = title.strip()\n    if not title:\n        raise InvalidContent(\"The title cannot be empty.\")\n    return title\n\n\ndef parse_nav_order(value: str) -> int:\n    try:\n        return int(value.strip())\n    except ValueError:\n        raise InvalidContent(\"Nav order must be a whole number, like 10.\") from None\n\n\nclass Store:\n    \"\"\"One kind of content, kept in its own table.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, table: str, noun: str, plural: str, *, published_order: str,\n                 has_nav_order: bool = False):\n        self.table, self.noun, self.plural = table, noun, plural\n        self.has_nav_order = has_nav_order\n        self._published_order = published_order\n        nav = f\"{table}.nav_order, \" if has_nav_order else \"\"\n        self._select = (\n            f\"SELECT {table}.id, title, slug, body, status, {table}.created_at, updated_at, \"\n            f\"{nav}{table}.author_id, users.name AS author \"\n            f\"FROM {table} JOIN users ON users.id = {table}.author_id\"\n        )\n\n    def create(self, title: str, body: str, author_id: int,\n               nav_order: int | None = None) -> int:\n        title = _clean_title(title)\n        now = _now()\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            columns = [\"title\", \"slug\", \"body\", \"status\", \"author_id\", \"created_at\", \"updated_at\"]\n            values = [title, _unique_slug(conn, title, self.noun), body, \"draft\",\n                      author_id, now, now]\n            if self.has_nav_order:\n                if nav_order is None:  # a new page goes to the end of the menu\n                    nav_order = conn.execute(\n                        f\"SELECT COALESCE(MAX(nav_order), 0) + 1 FROM {self.table}\").fetchone()[0]\n                columns.append(\"nav_order\")\n                values.append(nav_order)\n            cursor = conn.execute(\n                f\"INSERT INTO {self.table} ({', '.join(columns)}) \"\n                f\"VALUES ({', '.join('?' * len(values))})\", values)\n            return cursor.lastrowid\n\n    def edit(self, item_id: int, title: str, body: str, *, slug: str | None = None,\n             nav_order: int | None = None) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Save an edit. A new slug is made URL-safe and unique; None or blank\n        keeps the current one.\"\"\"\n        title = _clean_title(title)\n        changes = {\"title\": title, \"body\": body, \"updated_at\": _now()}\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            if slug is not None:\n                current = conn.execute(f\"SELECT slug FROM {self.table} WHERE id = ?\",\n                                       (item_id,)).fetchone()\n                if slug.strip() and not slugify(slug):\n                    raise InvalidContent(\"A slug needs at least one letter or number.\")\n                if current and slugify(slug) not in (\"\", current[\"slug\"]):\n                    changes[\"slug\"] = _unique_slug(conn, slug, self.noun, keep=current[\"slug\"])\n            if nav_order is not None and self.has_nav_order:\n                changes[\"nav_order\"] = nav_order\n            conn.execute(\n                f\"UPDATE {self.table} SET {', '.join(f'{k} = ?' for k in changes)} WHERE id = ?\",\n                (*changes.values(), item_id))\n\n    def publish(self, item_id: int) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Mark published. Going live counts as an update, so fans see a fresh date.\"\"\"\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            conn.execute(f\"UPDATE {self.table} SET status = 'published', updated_at = ? \"\n                         \"WHERE id = ?\", (_now(), item_id))\n\n    def unpublish(self, item_id: int) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Back to draft. The next `cms publish` removes it from the site.\"\"\"\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            conn.execute(f\"UPDATE {self.table} SET status = 'draft' WHERE id = ?\", (item_id,))\n\n    def delete(self, item_id: int) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Gone for good. If it was published, the next `cms publish` removes it.\"\"\"\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            conn.execute(f\"DELETE FROM {self.table} WHERE id = ?\", (item_id,))\n\n    def get(self, item_id: int) -> sqlite3.Row | None:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            return conn.execute(f\"{self._select} WHERE {self.table}.id = ?\",\n                                (item_id,)).fetchone()\n\n    def list_all(self) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            return conn.execute(f\"{self._select} \"\n                                f\"ORDER BY updated_at DESC, {self.table}.id DESC\").fetchall()\n\n    def list_published(self) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n        \"\"\"What `cms publish` exports, in the order the public site shows it.\"\"\"\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            return conn.execute(f\"{self._select} WHERE status = 'published' \"\n                                f\"ORDER BY {self._published_order}\").fetchall()\n\n\n# The home page orders updates by when they were first written, not updated_at,\n# so a correction never jumps above a newer update (CONTEXT.md, Decisions).\nUPDATES = Store(\"posts\", \"update\", \"updates\",\n                published_order=\"posts.created_at DESC, posts.id DESC\")\nPAGES = Store(\"pages\", \"page\", \"pages\", has_nav_order=True,\n              published_order=\"pages.nav_order, pages.title, pages.id\")\n\"\"\"Write, edit, publish, unpublish, and delete updates and pages.\n\ncontent_router(store) builds the same routes for each kind of content, so\npages follow exactly the rules updates do. Every route requires a signed-in\nuser; publish and unpublish require the admin, and editing or deleting is\nchecked against app/permissions.py. Only the admin may change a slug or set a\npage's nav order.\n\nThe editor form has two buttons: Save stores the item, Preview re-renders the\nform with the sanitized Markdown and stores nothing. Publishing only marks the\nitem; it reaches the public site at the next `cms publish` and `cms deploy`.\n\nCSRF is a parameter after `user` (not `dependencies=[...]`, which FastAPI runs\nfirst) so an anonymous POST is sent to login rather than refused with 403.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Form, HTTPException, Request\nfrom fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse\n\nfrom app import auth, markdown, permissions\nfrom app.content import InvalidContent, Store, parse_nav_order\nfrom app.templating import flash, templates\n\n\ndef content_router(store: Store) -> APIRouter:\n    prefix = f\"/admin/{store.plural}\"\n    noun = store.noun\n    router = APIRouter(prefix=prefix)\n\n    def editor_page(request: Request, user, *, item=None, title: str = \"\", body: str = \"\",\n                    slug: str | None = None, nav_order: str | None = None,\n                    error: str = \"\", status: int = 200):\n        may_edit = item is None or permissions.may_edit(user, item)\n        if nav_order is None and item is not None and store.has_nav_order:\n            nav_order = str(item[\"nav_order\"])\n        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n            request, \"admin/content_edit.html\",\n            {\"title\": f\"Edit {noun}\" if item else f\"New {noun}\", \"user\": user,\n             \"kind\": store, \"item\": item,\n             \"action\": f\"{prefix}/{item['id']}\" if item else prefix,\n             \"form_title\": title, \"body\": body,\n             \"slug\": item[\"slug\"] if slug is None and item else slug or \"\",\n             \"nav_order\": nav_order or \"\",\n             \"preview\": markdown.render(body), \"error\": error,\n             \"may_delete\": item is not None and permissions.may_delete(user, item),\n             \"refused_reason\": \"\" if may_edit else permissions.PUBLISHED_IS_ADMIN_ONLY},\n            status_code=status,\n        )\n\n    def get_or_404(item_id: int):\n        item = store.get(item_id)\n        if item is None:\n            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=f\"No such {noun}\")\n        return item\n\n    def admin_fields(user, item, slug: str | None, nav_order: str | None):\n        \"\"\"Check and parse the admin-only fields; None means leave unchanged.\"\"\"\n        if not store.has_nav_order:\n            nav_order = None\n        permissions.check_admin_fields(user, item, slug=slug, nav_order=nav_order)\n        if not permissions.is_admin(user):\n            return None, None\n        parsed = parse_nav_order(nav_order) if nav_order and nav_order.strip() else None\n        return slug, parsed\n\n    @router.get(\"\", name=f\"list_{store.plural}\")\n    def list_items(request: Request, user=auth.SIGNED_IN):\n        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n            request, \"admin/content_list.html\",\n            {\"title\": store.plural.capitalize(), \"user\": user, \"kind\": store,\n             \"items\": store.list_all()},\n        )\n\n    @router.get(\"/new\", name=f\"new_{noun}\")\n    def new_item(request: Request, user=auth.SIGNED_IN):\n        return editor_page(request, user)\n\n    @router.post(\"\", name=f\"create_{noun}\")\n    def create_item(request: Request, user=auth.SIGNED_IN, _csrf=auth.CSRF,\n                    title: str = Form(\"\"), body: str = Form(\"\"),\n                    nav_order: str | None = Form(None), action: str = Form(\"save\")):\n        if action == \"preview\":\n            return editor_page(request, user, title=title, body=body, nav_order=nav_order)\n        try:\n            _, order = admin_fields(user, None, None, nav_order)\n            item_id = store.create(title, body, user[\"id\"], nav_order=order)\n        except InvalidContent as exc:\n            return editor_page(request, user, title=title, body=body, nav_order=nav_order,\n                               error=str(exc), status=400)\n        flash(request, \"success\", \"Draft saved.\")\n        return RedirectResponse(f\"{prefix}/{item_id}\", status_code=303)\n\n    @router.get(\"/{item_id}\", name=f\"show_{noun}\")\n    def show_item(request: Request, item_id: int, user=auth.SIGNED_IN):\n        item = get_or_404(item_id)\n        return editor_page(request, user, item=item, title=item[\"title\"], body=item[\"body\"])\n\n    @router.post(\"/{item_id}\", name=f\"save_{noun}\")\n    def save_item(request: Request, item_id: int, user=auth.SIGNED_IN, _csrf=auth.CSRF,\n                  title: str = Form(\"\"), body: str = Form(\"\"), slug: str | None = Form(None),\n                  nav_order: str | None = Form(None), action: str = Form(\"save\")):\n        item = get_or_404(item_id)\n        permissions.check_edit(user, item)\n        form = {\"title\": title, \"body\": body, \"slug\": slug, \"nav_order\": nav_order}\n        if action == \"preview\":\n            return editor_page(request, user, item=item, **form)\n        try:\n            new_slug, order = admin_fields(user, item, slug, nav_order)\n            store.edit(item_id, title, body, slug=new_slug, nav_order=order)\n        except InvalidContent as exc:\n            return editor_page(request, user, item=item, **form, error=str(exc), status=400)\n        flash(request, \"success\", \"Changes saved.\")\n        return RedirectResponse(f\"{prefix}/{item_id}\", status_code=303)\n\n    def change_status(request: Request, item_id: int, change, message: str):\n        get_or_404(item_id)\n        change(item_id)\n        flash(request, \"success\", message)\n        return RedirectResponse(f\"{prefix}/{item_id}\", status_code=303)\n\n    @router.post(\"/{item_id}/publish\", name=f\"publish_{noun}\")\n    def publish_item(request: Request, item_id: int, user=auth.ADMIN, _csrf=auth.CSRF):\n        return change_status(request, item_id, store.publish,\n                             \"Published. Run cms publish and cms deploy to put it live.\")\n\n    @router.post(\"/{item_id}/unpublish\", name=f\"unpublish_{noun}\")\n    def unpublish_item(request: Request, item_id: int, user=auth.ADMIN, _csrf=auth.CSRF):\n        return change_status(request, item_id, store.unpublish,\n                             \"Unpublished. Run cms publish and cms deploy to take it down.\")\n\n    @router.get(\"/{item_id}/delete\", name=f\"confirm_delete_{noun}\")\n    def confirm_delete(request: Request, item_id: int, user=auth.SIGNED_IN):\n        item = get_or_404(item_id)\n        permissions.check_delete(user, item)\n        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n            request, \"admin/content_delete.html\",\n            {\"title\": f\"Delete {noun}\", \"user\": user, \"kind\": store, \"item\": item},\n        )\n\n    @router.post(\"/{item_id}/delete\", name=f\"delete_{noun}\")\n    def delete_item(request: Request, item_id: int, user=auth.SIGNED_IN, _csrf=auth.CSRF):\n        item = get_or_404(item_id)\n        permissions.check_delete(user, item)\n        store.delete(item_id)\n        if item[\"status\"] == \"published\":\n            flash(request, \"success\", f\"Deleted “{item['title']}”. \"\n                                      \"Run cms publish and cms deploy to take it down.\")\n        else:\n            flash(request, \"success\", f\"Deleted the draft “{item['title']}”.\")\n        return RedirectResponse(prefix, status_code=303)\n\n    return router\n\"\"\"The admin console home. Every route here requires a signed-in user.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Request\n\nfrom app import auth\nfrom app.templating import templates\n\nrouter = APIRouter()\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin\")\ndef admin_home(request: Request, user=auth.SIGNED_IN):\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/hello.html\", {\"title\": \"Admin\", \"user\": user},\n    )\n\"\"\"The FastAPI application.\n\nThe admin console answers at /admin (behind login) and the public preview at /.\nRoutes live in their own modules under app/routes/ and are included here. Keep\nthis file small.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import FastAPI, Request\nfrom fastapi.responses import HTMLResponse, RedirectResponse\nfrom starlette.middleware.sessions import SessionMiddleware\n\nfrom app import auth, settings\nfrom app.publish import render_home\nfrom app.content import PAGES, UPDATES\nfrom app.routes import admin, login\nfrom app.routes.content import content_router\nfrom app.templating import templates\n\n\ndef create_app() -> FastAPI:\n    app = FastAPI(title=\"IPHS 400 MP2 CMS\")\n    app.add_middleware(SessionMiddleware, secret_key=settings.SECRET_KEY,\n                       session_cookie=\"cms_session\", same_site=\"strict\")\n\n    @app.exception_handler(auth.LoginRequired)\n    def send_to_login(request: Request, exc: auth.LoginRequired):\n        return RedirectResponse(\"/login\", status_code=303)\n\n    @app.exception_handler(auth.Refused)\n    def refused_screen(request: Request, exc: auth.Refused):\n        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n            request, \"admin/refused.html\",\n            {\"title\": \"Not allowed\", \"reason\": exc.detail,\n             \"user\": auth.signed_in_user(request)},\n            status_code=403,\n        )\n\n    app.include_router(login.router)\n    app.include_router(admin.router)\n    app.include_router(content_router(UPDATES))\n    app.include_router(content_router(PAGES))\n\n    @app.get(\"/\", response_class=HTMLResponse)\n    def public_home():\n        # A quick look at the home page. The full site, with its stylesheet\n        # and update pages, is what `cms publish` writes to site/.\n        return render_home()\n\n    return app\n\n\napp = create_app()\n\"\"\"SQLite access. Every call opens a short-lived connection to the current\nsettings.DATABASE_PATH, so tests can point it at a temporary file.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\nfrom contextlib import contextmanager\nfrom collections.abc import Iterator\n\nfrom app import settings\n\nSCHEMA = \"\"\"\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (\n    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    email         TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE,\n    name          TEXT NOT NULL,\n    password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,\n    role          TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('admin', 'editor')),\n    active        INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,\n    created_at    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- An Update is stored as a post (see CONTEXT.md).\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS posts (\n    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    title      TEXT NOT NULL,\n    slug       TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,\n    body       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    status     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft' CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'published')),\n    author_id  INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id),\n    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,\n    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL\n);\n\n-- A Page: the same fields as an update, plus its place in the public menu.\n-- Slugs are unique across posts and pages together (app/content.py).\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pages (\n    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    title      TEXT NOT NULL,\n    slug       TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,\n    body       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    status     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft' CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'published')),\n    nav_order  INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    author_id  INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id),\n    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,\n    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL\n);\n\"\"\"\n\n\n@contextmanager\ndef connect() -> Iterator[sqlite3.Connection]:\n    \"\"\"Yield a connection with the schema in place; commit on success.\"\"\"\n    conn = sqlite3.connect(settings.DATABASE_PATH)\n    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row\n    try:\n        conn.executescript(SCHEMA)\n        yield conn\n        conn.commit()\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\"\"\"The Jinja environment shared by the admin console routes.\n\nEvery admin template gets `csrf_token`, so each state-changing form can carry\nit without each route passing it by hand, and `flash`, the one-time message a\nroute left with flash() before redirecting.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import Request\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\n\nfrom app import auth, settings\n\n\ndef flash(request: Request, kind: str, text: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Leave a message (\"success\" or \"error\") for the next page rendered.\"\"\"\n    request.session[\"flash\"] = {\"kind\": kind, \"text\": text}\n\n\ndef _csrf(request: Request) -> dict[str, str]:\n    return {\"csrf_token\": auth.csrf_token(request)}\n\n\ndef _flash(request: Request) -> dict[str, dict | None]:\n    return {\"flash\": request.session.pop(\"flash\", None)}\n\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES),\n                            context_processors=[_csrf, _flash])\n\"\"\"Sessions, CSRF tokens, and the signed-in user.\n\nThe session lives in a signed cookie (Starlette's SessionMiddleware). It holds\nonly the user id and the CSRF token, never a password.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport hmac\nimport secrets\nimport sqlite3\n\nfrom fastapi import Depends, HTTPException, Request\n\nfrom app import users\n\n\nclass LoginRequired(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised for an anonymous visitor; main.py turns it into a redirect.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass Refused(HTTPException):\n    \"\"\"A signed-in user tried something their role does not allow. main.py\n    shows the \"not allowed\" screen with this reason, as a 403.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, reason: str):\n        super().__init__(status_code=403, detail=reason)\n\n\ndef csrf_token(request: Request) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Return this session's CSRF token, creating one if needed.\"\"\"\n    token = request.session.get(\"csrf_token\")\n    if not token:\n        token = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)\n        request.session[\"csrf_token\"] = token\n    return token\n\n\nasync def check_csrf(request: Request) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Dependency for every state-changing route: reject a missing or wrong token.\"\"\"\n    form = await request.form()\n    sent = form.get(\"csrf_token\")\n    expected = request.session.get(\"csrf_token\")\n    if not (isinstance(sent, str) and expected\n            and hmac.compare_digest(sent, expected)):\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail=\"Invalid or missing CSRF token\")\n\n\ndef signed_in_user(request: Request) -> sqlite3.Row | None:\n    \"\"\"The signed-in, still-active user, or None.\"\"\"\n    user_id = request.session.get(\"user_id\")\n    return users.get_active_user(user_id) if user_id else None\n\n\ndef current_user(request: Request) -> sqlite3.Row:\n    \"\"\"Dependency for every admin screen: the signed-in, still-active user.\"\"\"\n    user = signed_in_user(request)\n    if user is None:\n        request.session.pop(\"user_id\", None)\n        raise LoginRequired\n    return user\n\n\ndef admin_user(user: sqlite3.Row = Depends(current_user)) -> sqlite3.Row:\n    \"\"\"Dependency for admin-only actions: an editor is refused with 403.\"\"\"\n    if user[\"role\"] != \"admin\":\n        raise Refused(\"Only the admin can do this.\")\n    return user\n\n\ndef start_session(request: Request, user: sqlite3.Row) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Begin a fresh session for the user, with a new CSRF token.\"\"\"\n    request.session.clear()\n    request.session[\"user_id\"] = user[\"id\"]\n    csrf_token(request)\n\n\ndef end_session(request: Request) -> None:\n    request.session.clear()\n\n\nCSRF = Depends(check_csrf)\nSIGNED_IN = Depends(current_user)\nADMIN = Depends(admin_user)","stderr":"","interrupted":false,"isImage":false,"noOutputExpected":false},"serverClassifierContext":{"request":"7613975e-c9c6-45fb-8b49-9472eb7cd0ce","context":{"git_state":{"cwd":"/Users/maysg/orca/iphs400-mp2-cms","root":"/Users/maysg/orca/iphs400-mp2-cms","branch":"main","default_branch":"main","status":{"clean":false,"counts":{"staged":0,"modified":1,"untracked":null,"untracked_normal":1},"porcelain":null,"truncated":false},"visibility":{"origin":{"host":"github.com","remote":"MaysG-creator/iphs400-mp2-cms","visibility":"public"},"push_remote":"origin","remotes":[{"name":"origin","host":"github.com","remote":"MaysG-creator/iphs400-mp2-cms","visibility":"public"}],"visibility_cache":[{"host":"github.com","remote":"MaysG-creator/iphs400-mp2-cms","visibility":"public"}]}},"live_cwd":"/Users/maysg/orca/iphs400-mp2-cms","platform":"macos"}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"a1cfa5b2-b0a4-45c2-aa15-4a2d345a832f","permissionDecision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reasonType":"classifier"},"session_id":"a121db57-1bee-4dbb-8856-8744e70c4142","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/maysg/orca/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"91f90b48-e4a0-44e0-aa4c-47594fc96da9","version":"2.1.296","gitBranch":"main"}

}\n    body { font: 16px/1.5 system-ui, sans-serif; margin: 0 auto; max-width: 48rem; padding: 1rem; }\n    nav { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .5rem 1rem; align-items: center;\n          border-bottom: 1px solid #ccc; padding-bottom: .5rem; }\n    nav form { margin-left: auto; }\n    label { display: block; margin-top: 1rem; }\n    input, textarea { width: 100%; max-width: 24rem; padding: .5rem; font: inherit; }\n    textarea { max-width: none; min-height: 12rem; }\n    button { margin-top: 1rem; padding: .5rem 1rem; font: inherit; }\n    nav button { margin-top: 0; }\n    .error { border: 1px solid #b00020; color: #b00020; padding: .5rem; }\n    .success { border: 1px solid #1b5e20; color: #1b5e20; padding: .5rem; }\n    .preview { border: 1px dashed #999; padding: 0 1rem; }\n    .preview img { max-width: 100%; }\n    .preview pre { overflow-x: auto; }\n    table { border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; }\n    th, td { text-align: left; padding: .25rem .5rem .25rem 0; vertical-align: top; }\n    main { overflow-wrap: anywhere; }\n  </style>\n</head>\n<body>\n  {% if user %}\n  <nav>\n    <strong>CMS admin</strong>\n    <a href=\"{{ url_for('admin_home').path }}\">Home</a>\n    <a href=\"{{ url_for('list_updates').path }}\">Updates</a>\n    <a href=\"{{ url_for('new_update').path }}\">New update</a>\n    <a href=\"{{ url_for('list_pages').path }}\">Pages</a>\n    <a href=\"{{ url_for('new_page').path }}\">New page</a>\n    <span>{{ user.name }} ({{ user.email }}, {{ user.role }})</span>\n    <form method=\"post\" action=\"/logout\">\n      <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{{ csrf_token }}\">\n      <button type=\"submit\">Log out</button>\n    </form>\n  </nav>\n  {% endif %}\n  <main>\n    {% if flash %}<p class=\"{{ flash.kind }}\" role=\"status\">{{ flash.text }}</p>{% endif %}\n    {% block content %}{% endblock %}\n  </main>\n</body>\n</html>\n=== templates/admin/content_delete.html\n{% extends \"admin/base.html\" %}\n{% block content %}\n  <h1>Delete “{{ item.title }}”?</h1>\n  {% if item.status == \"published\" %}\n  <p class=\"error\" role=\"alert\">This {{ kind.noun }} is published. Deleting it removes it from the\n     public site at the next <code>cms publish</code> and <code>cms deploy</code>.</p>\n  {% endif %}\n  <p>This cannot be undone.</p>\n  <form method=\"post\" action=\"{{ url_for('delete_' ~ kind.noun, item_id=item.id).path }}\">\n    <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{{ csrf_token }}\">\n    <button type=\"submit\">Yes, delete it</button>\n  </form>\n  <p><a href=\"{{ url_for('show_' ~ kind.noun, item_id=item.id).path }}\">No, keep it</a></p>\n{% endblock %}\n=== templates/admin/content_edit.html\n{% extends {"parentUuid":"5be96f9c-1726-469d-a00a-eec9c27b57a3","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011CfzPqxctVJkPiKZqTKn3w","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01PJy5wwgzWytCbLo14dbjqL","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/maysg/orca/iphs400-mp2-cms/tests/test_t06_dashboard.py","content":"\"\"\"T06: dashboard and content list (issue #7).\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom conftest import create, visible\nfrom test_t03_publish import post_status_form\nfrom test_t05_pages import create_page, publish_page\n\nCONTENT = \"/admin/content\"\n\n\ndef publish_update(client, title: str) -> str:\n    url = create(client, title)\n    assert post_status_form(client, url, \"publish\").status_code == 303\n    return url\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef mixed(client_as):\n    \"\"\"Two update drafts, one published update, one page draft, one published page.\"\"\"\n    admin, editor = client_as(\"admin\"), client_as(\"editor\")\n    create(editor, \"Draft update one (sample)\")\n    create(admin, \"Draft update two (sample)\")\n    publish_update(admin, \"Live update (sample)\")\n    create_page(editor, \"Draft page (sample)\")\n    publish_page(admin, \"Live page (sample)\")\n    return admin, editor\n\n\ndef row_titles(html: str) -> list[str]:\n    body = re.search(r\"<tbody>.*?</tbody>\", html, re.S)\n    if not body:\n        return []\n    return [visible(re.search(r\"<a [^>]*>(.*?)</a>\", row, re.S).group(1))\n            for row in re.findall(r\"<tr>.*?</tr>\", body.group(0), re.S)]\n\n\ndef row_for(html: str, title: str) -> str:\n    for row in re.findall(r\"<tr>.*?</tr>\", html, re.S):\n        if title in row:\n            return visible(row)\n    raise AssertionError(f\"no row for {title}\")\n\n\n# --- dashboard -------------------------------------------------------------\n\ndef test_dashboard_counts_match_the_data(mixed):\n    admin, _ = mixed\n    text = visible(admin.get(\"/admin\").text)\n    assert \"Drafts 3\" in text\n    assert \"Published updates 1\" in text\n    assert \"Pages 2\" in text\n\n\ndef test_dashboard_counts_follow_a_status_change(mixed):\n    admin, _ = mixed\n    url = publish_update(admin, \"Another live one (sample)\")\n    assert \"Published updates 2\" in visible(admin.get(\"/admin\").text)\n    post_status_form(admin, url, \"unpublish\")\n    text = visible(admin.get(\"/admin\").text)\n    assert \"Published updates 1\" in text and \"Drafts 4\" in text\n\n\ndef test_empty_dashboard_shows_zero_counts(client_as):\n    text = visible(client_as(\"admin\").get(\"/admin\").text)\n    assert \"Drafts 0\" in text and \"Published updates 0\" in text and \"Pages 0\" in text\n\n\ndef test_dashboard_counts_link_to_the_matching_list(client_as):\n    page = client_as(\"admin\").get(\"/admin\").text\n    assert f'href=\"{CONTENT}?status=draft\"' in page\n    assert f'href=\"{CONTENT}?status=published&amp;type=update\"' in page\n    assert f'href=\"{CONTENT}?type=page\"' in page\n\n\n# --- content list ----------------------------------------------------------\n\ndef test_content_list_shows_updates_and_pages_together(mixed):\n    admin, _ = mixed\n    html = admin.get(CONTENT).text\n    assert sorted(row_titles(html)) == sorted([\n        \"Draft update one (sample)\", \"Draft update two (sample)\", \"Live update (sample)\",\n        \"Draft page (sample)\", \"Live page (sample)\"])\n    row = row_for(html, \"Draft page (sample)\")\n    assert \"Page\" in row and \"Draft\" in row and \"Sample Editor\" in row\n    assert re.search(r\"\\d{4}-\\d\\d-\\d\\d\", row)\n    row = row_for(html, \"Live update (sample)\")\n    assert \"Update\" in row and \"Published\" in row and \"Sample Admin\" in row\n\n\ndef test_content_list_links_each_row_to_its_editor(mixed):\n    admin, _ = mixed\n    html = admin.get(CONTENT).text\n    assert re.search(r'href=\"/admin/updates/\\d+\"[^>]*>Live update', html)\n    assert re.search(r'href=\"/admin/pages/\\d+\"[^>]*>Live page', html)\n\n\ndef test_content_list_shows_the_most_recently_updated_first(mixed):\n    admin, _ = mixed\n    assert row_titles(admin.get(CONTENT).text)[0] == \"Live page (sample)\"\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"query,expected\", [\n    (\"status=draft\", {\"Draft update one (sample)\", \"Draft update two (sample)\",\n                      \"Draft page (sample)\"}),\n    (\"status=published\", {\"Live update (sample)\", \"Live page (sample)\"}),\n    (\"type=update\", {\"Draft update one (sample)\", \"Draft update two (sample)\",\n                     \"Live update (sample)\"}),\n    (\"type=page\", {\"Draft page (sample)\", \"Live page (sample)\"}),\n    (\"status=draft&type=page\", {\"Draft page (sample)\"}),\n    (\"status=published&type=update\", {\"Live update (sample)\"}),\n])\ndef test_content_list_filters_by_status_and_type_and_they_combine(mixed, query, expected):\n    admin, _ = mixed\n    assert set(row_titles(admin.get(f\"{CONTENT}?{query}\").text)) == expected\n\n\ndef test_filter_form_keeps_the_chosen_filters(mixed):\n    admin, _ = mixed\n    html = admin.get(f\"{CONTENT}?status=draft&type=page\").text\n    assert re.search(r'<option value=\"draft\" selected>', html)\n    assert re.search(r'<option value=\"page\" selected>', html)\n\n\ndef test_unknown_filter_value_shows_everything(mixed):\n    admin, _ = mixed\n    assert len(row_titles(admin.get(f\"{CONTENT}?status=bogus&type=\").text)) == 5\n\n\ndef test_filter_with_no_matches_shows_a_clear_empty_message(client_as):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    create(admin, \"Only a draft (sample)\")\n    html =     for row in re.findall(r\"<tr>.*?</tr>\", body.group(0), re.S)]\n\n\ndef row_for(html: str, title: str) -> str:\n    for row in re.findall(r\"<tr>.*?</tr>\", html, re.S):\n        if title in assert \"Pages 2\" in text\n\n\ndef test_dashboard_counts_follow_a_status_change(mixed):\n    admin, _ = mixed\n    url = publish_update(admin, \"Another live one (sample)\")\n    assert \"Published then /bin/sh \"${HOME-}/.orca/agent-hooks/claude-hook.sh\"; else { command -p cat 2>/dev/null || cat; } >/dev/null 2>&1 || :; printf '{}\\n'; fi ;; esac; fi","durationMs":26},"type":"attachment","uuid":"a48e3afe-2436-438e-bc5d-32be219de064","timestamp":"2026-10-13T14:31:52.316Z","session_id":"a121db57-1bee-4dbb-8856-8744e70c4142","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/maysg/orca/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"91f90b48-e4a0-44e0-aa4c-47594fc96da9","version":"2.1.296","gitBranch":"main"}
{"parentUuid":"a48e3afe-2436-438e-bc5d-32be219de064","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"b166393f-ae29-48ab-a7bb-82b437a312be","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Base directory for this skill: /Users/maysg/.claude/plugins/cache/claude-plugins-official/mattpocock-skills/1.2.3/skills/engineering/code-review\n\nTwo-axis review of the diff between `HEAD` and a fixed point the user supplies:\n\n- **Standards**: does the code conform to this repo's documented coding standards?\n- **Spec**: does the code faithfully implement the originating issue / spec?\n\nBoth axes run as **parallel sub-agents** so they don't pollute each other's context, then this skill aggregates their findings.\n\nThe issue tracker should have been provided to you. If `docs/agents/issue-tracker.md` is missing, tell the user to run `/setup-matt-pocock-skills`.\n\n## Process\n\n### 1. Pin the fixed point\n\nWhatever the user said is the fixed point (a commit SHA, branch name, tag, `main`, `HEAD~5`, etc.). If they didn't specify one, ask for it.\n\nCapture the diff command once: `git diff <fixed-point>...HEAD` (three-dot, so the comparison is against the merge-base). Also note the list of commits via `git log <fixed-point>..HEAD --oneline`.\n\nBefore going further, confirm the fixed point resolves (`git rev-parse <fixed-point>`) and the diff is non-empty. A bad ref or empty diff should fail here, not inside two parallel sub-agents.\n\n### 2. Identify the spec source\n\nLook for the originating spec, in this order:\n\n1. Issue references in the commit messages (`#123`, `Closes #45`, GitLab `!67`, etc.), fetched via the workflow in `docs/agents/issue-tracker.md`.\n2. A path the user passed as an argument.\n3. A spec file under `docs/`, `specs/`, or `.scratch/` matching the branch name or feature.\n4. If nothing is found, ask the user where the spec is. If they say there isn't one, the **Spec** sub-agent will skip and report \"no spec available\".\n\n### 3. Identify the standards sources\n\nAnything in the repo that documents how code should be written, such as `CODING_STANDARDS.md` or `CONTRIBUTING.md`.\n\nOn top of whatever the repo documents, the Standards axis always carries the **smell baseline** below: a fixed set of Fowler code smells (_Refactoring_, ch.3) that applies even when a repo documents nothing. Two rules bind it:\n\n- **The repo overrides.** A documented repo standard always wins; where it endorses something the baseline would flag, suppress the smell.\n- **Always a judgement call.** Each smell is a labelled heuristic (\"possible Feature Envy\"), never a hard violation. Like any standard here, skip anything tooling already enforces.\n\nEach smell reads *what it is* → *how to fix*; match it against the diff:\n\n- **Mysterious Name**: a function, variable, or type whose name doesn't reveal what it does or holds. → rename it; if no honest name comes, the design's murky.\n- **Duplicated Code**: the same logic shape appears in more than one hunk or file in the change. → extract the shared shape, call it from both.\n- **Feature Envy**: a method that reaches into another object's data more than its own. → move the method onto the data it envies.\n- **Data Clumps**: the same few fields or params keep travelling together (a type wanting to be born). → bundle them into one type, pass that.\n- **Primitive Obsession**: a primitive or string standing in for a domain concept that deserves its own type. → give the concept its own small type.\n- **Repeated Switches**: the same `switch`/`if`-cascade on the same type recurs across the change. → replace with polymorphism, or one map both sites share.\n- **Shotgun Surgery**: one logical change forces scattered edits across many files in the diff. → gather what changes together into one module.\n- **Divergent Change**: one file or module is edited for several unrelated reasons. → split so each module changes for one reason.\n- **Speculative Generality**: abstraction, parameters, or hooks added for needs the spec doesn't have. → delete it; inline back until a real need shows.\n- **Message Chains**: long `a.b().c().d()` navigation the caller shouldn't depend on. → hide the walk behind one method on the first object.\n- **Middle Man**: a class or function that mostly just delegates onward. → cut it, call the real target direct.\n- **Refused Bequest**: a subclass or implementer that ignores or overrides most of what it inherits. → drop the inheritance, use composition.\n\n### 4. Spawn both sub-agents in parallel\n\n**Standards sub-agent prompt** should include:\n\n- The full diff command and commit list.\n- The list of standards-source files you found in step 3, **plus the smell baseline from step 3** pasted in full (the sub-agent has no other access to it).\n- The brief: \"Report, per file/hunk where relevant, (a) every place the diff violates a documented standard: cite the standard (file + the rule); and (b) any baseline smell you spot: name it and quote the hunk. Distinguish hard violations from judgement calls: documented-standard breaches can be hard, but baseline smells are always judgement calls, and a documented repo standard overrides the baseline. Skip anything tooling enforces. Under 400 words.\"\n\n**Spec sub-agent prompt** should include:\n\n- The diff command and commit list.\n- The path or fetched contents of the spec.\n- The brief: \"Report: (a) requirements the spec asked for that are missing or partial; (b) behaviour in the diff that wasn't asked for (scope creep); (c) requirements that look implemented but where the implementation looks wrong. Quote the spec line for each finding. Under 400 words.\"\n\nIf the spec is missing, skip the Spec sub-agent and note this in the final report.\n\n### 5. Aggregate\n\nPresent the two reports under `## Standards` and `## Spec` headings, verbatim or lightly cleaned. Do **not** merge or rerank findings, because the two axes are deliberately separate (see _Why two axes_).\n\nEnd with a one-line summary: total findings per axis, and the worst issue _within each axis_ (if any). Don't pick a single winner across axes: that's the reranking the separation exists to prevent.\n\n## Why two axes\n\nA change can pass one axis and fail the other:\n\n- Code that follows every standard but implements the wrong thing → **Standards pass, Spec fail.**\n- Code that does exactly what the issue asked but breaks the project's conventions → **Spec pass, Standards fail.**\n\nReporting them separately stops one axis from masking the other.\n\n\nARGUMENTS: Review uncommitted working-tree changes since HEAD (f98a1b5) for ticket #7 (T06: Dashboard and content list). Ignore notes/usage-ledger.csv and docs/transcripts/."}]},"isMeta":true,"turnCompanion":true,"uuid":"bf8823a3-3f89-4948-9ccb-e4de1e2d75c6","timestamp":"2026-10-13T14:31:52.288Z","sourceToolUseID":"toolu_019QRe14uxtS3tAKmJHKeNnm","session_id":"a121db57-1bee-4dbb-8856-8744e70c4142","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/maysg/orca/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"91f90b48-e4a0-44e0-aa4c-47594fc96da9","version":"2.1.296","gitBranch":"main"}

The diff touches nothing under `site/` or publishing, and adds no Markdown rendering. The admin console uses root-absolute `url_for().path`, but that matches existing admin templates, and the relative-path rule only covers published HTML.\n  \n  ### Documented-standard breaches\n  \n  **tests/test_t06_dashboard.py vs the spec's Testing Decisions** (`docs/tech-spec_web-cms_v1_sonnet5med_20261012.md:82`: \"never asserts on … table layouts, or template structure\"). Hard violation, though partly softened by prior art:\n  - `row_titles` / `row_for` parse `<tbody>`, `<tr>` and the first `<a>` in each row. That ties every content-list test to the table layout.\n  - `test_filter_form_keeps_the_chosen_filters` asserts `<option value=\"draft\" selected>`, which is pure template markup.\n  - `test_dashboard_and_list_are_built_to_fit_390px` asserts the viewport `<meta>` string. The spec also says small-screen fit is \"Not tested\" and is checked by hand.\n  - The nav split (`page.split(\"<nav\", 1)`) and the `href=` checks copy an existing pattern (`test_t02_updates.py:135`, `test_t04_editors.py:112`). That is a precedent, but it still technically breaks the rule.\n  \n  **CONTEXT.md vocabulary (\"use these words everywhere\"). Judgement call, leaning toward a breach.** One concept goes by four names: `kind` (a noun string in `list_content(kind=...)`, but a `Store` in the row dict, as in `routes/content.py`), `type` (the query param and template variable), `noun`, and `stores`. Pick one name for the \"update vs page\" concept, and don't let `kind` mean both a str and a Store.\n  \n  ### Baseline smells (all judgement calls)\n  \n  - **Duplicated Code / Primitive Obsession**, `app/content.py` `counts()`:\n    `count(\"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts WHERE status = 'published'\")`, `\"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pages\"`, `... WHERE status = 'draft'`\n    This hard-codes table names and status literals that `STORES`/`TABLES` and the new `STATUSES` already hold. The module now has three sources of truth for statuses: `STATUSES`, the SQL literals, and the db `CHECK`.\n  - **Feature Envy**, `counts()` (and `list_content` filtering in Python): it reaches into each table's SQL from outside `Store`, while every other query lives on `Store`. A `Store.count(status=None)` would keep this in line with `list_all`/`list_published`. `list_content` also loads every row and filters in Python, where `Store` could filter with SQL.\n  - **Mysterious Name**, `counts()` and `{% set list = ... %}` in `dashboard.html`. `list` hides the builtin-ish name; `content_list_url` would read clearer. `counts` would read better as `dashboard_counts`.\n  - **Shotgun Surgery (mild)**: adding a third content kind means editing `STORES`, `TABLES`, `counts()` and the `type`→plural logic in the empty-state message in `content_all.html` (`stores[type].plural`).\n  \n  Files: `/Users/maysg/orca/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/content.py`, `/Users/maysg/orca/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/routes/admin.py`, `/Users/maysg/orca/iphs400-mp2-cms/templates/admin/content_all.html`, `/Users/maysg/orca/iphs400-mp2-cms/templates/admin/dashboard.html`, `/Users/maysg/orca/iphs400-mp2-cms/tests/test_t06_dashboard.py`.\n</agent-message>"}

The report follows:\n  Spec-axis review of T06 (issue #7, parent #1). `uv run pytest -q tests/test_t06_dashboard.py`: 30 passed. Nothing in the spec is clearly missing. One count needs a decision before you tick that box.\n  \n  **(a) Missing or partial**\n  - \"The dashboard and list fit 390 px wide with no sideways scrolling\". No automated test proves this. `test_dashboard_and_list_are_built_to_fit_390px` only checks the viewport meta tag. Parent spec \"Testing Decisions\" says visual checks are \"checked by hand and with screenshots at … 390 px\", so the hand check counts. A test name that says \"fit\" without testing it may overstate coverage.\n  \n  **(c) Implemented, but may be wrong**\n  - \"The dashboard shows counts of drafts, published updates, and pages that match the data\" (story 20: \"counts of drafts, published updates, and pages\"). `counts()` counts *all* pages, drafts included, while Drafts also counts draft pages. A draft page is therefore counted twice. In the test fixture, Drafts 3 and Pages 2 add up to 5 tiles of meaning from 4 distinct buckets. The pattern \"published updates\" suggests \"pages\" might mean published pages. The spec is ambiguous, so pick a reading and either note it on the issue or add it to CONTEXT.md.\n  - `list_content` sorts only by `updated_at`, which is stored to the second. On a tie, updates always come before pages (the sort is stable and follows `STORES` order), so the order is decided by kind, not recency. The spec doesn't require an order, so this is minor.\n  - \"A filter with no matches shows a clear empty message\". This works. With a status filter only, the text reads \"No draft items match these filters\". Acceptable.\n  \n  **(b) Not asked for (scope creep, all small and reasonable)**\n  - Dashboard count tiles link to pre-filtered lists, and there is a \"See all content\" link.\n  - Each list row links to its editor (`show_update`/`show_page`).\n  - Most-recently-updated-first ordering, with a dedicated test that includes a `time.sleep(1.1)`.\n  - Unknown or blank filter values silently mean \"any\" (`test_unknown_filter_value_shows_everything`).\n  - A separate \"Nothing has been written yet.\" message when there are no filters, plus a \"Show everything\" link.\n  - Selected filters persist in the form.\n  - A \"Content\" nav link. Story 19 arguably covers this (\"admin navigation visible on every screen\").\n  - `hello.html` is deleted and its greeting is replaced by \"Hello {role}, signed in as {name}\", which keeps `test_t00` passing.\n  \n  **Covered correctly**\n  - Combined list with title, type, status, author, and date.\n  - Status × type filters that combine (6 parametrized cases).\n  - Admin and editor both get 200 with the same counts, and anonymous visitors get a 303 to /login on `/admin` and `/admin/content`.\n  - Each acceptance criterion maps to at least one named test, except the 390 px one noted above.\n  \n  Files: /Users/maysg/orca/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/content.py, /Users/maysg/orca/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/routes/admin.py, /Users/maysg/orca/iphs400-mp2-cms/templates/admin/dashboard.html, /Users/maysg/orca/iphs400-mp2-cms/templates/admin/content_all.html, /Users/maysg/orca/iphs400-mp2-cms/tests/test_t06_dashboard.py\n</agent-message>"}

{"parentUuid":"38e92f4f-f4a1-4885-8096-4863df3f1e6e","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011CfzQHhn9jAj16SigsuuAV","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"T06 (issue #7) is done and committed to `main` as `2919a7a`, and all 213 tests pass. I haven't pushed it.\n\n**What it does:**\n- **Dashboard:** `/admin` now shows three counts: drafts (updates and pages together), published updates, and pages. Each count links to the content list with the matching filter already applied.\n- **Content list:** the new page at `/admin/content` shows updates and pages together, with title, type, status, author and last-updated date. You can filter by status and by type, and the two filters combine. When nothing matches, the page says so, for example \"No published updates match these filters.\", with a link back to everything.\n- **Who sees it:** admin and editor see the same screens, and anonymous visitors are sent to login. There's also a new \"Content\" link in the admin menu.\n- **390 px:** I checked this in headless Chrome, which can't open a window narrower than 500 px, so I loaded each page inside a 390 px frame. The dashboard, the full list and the empty list all fit with no sideways scrolling. On narrow screens each row of the list becomes a small card instead of a table row.\n\n**Code:** the main logic is in `app/content.py`, `app/routes/admin.py` and the new templates `admin/dashboard.html` and `admin/content_all.html`. The tests are in `tests/test_t06_dashboard.py`. The dashboard replaces the old `hello.html` placeholder. To keep `test_t00` passing unchanged, its greeting reads \"Hello admin\" (or \"Hello editor\").\n\n**Review:** I ran `/code-review` and posted every finding, with how I resolved it, as a comment on #7. I also ticked the issue's acceptance boxes. The main fixes:\n- Counting and filtering now go through the existing content store instead of separate SQL.\n- One name is used for \"update vs page\" throughout the code.\n- I renamed the 390 px test so it doesn't claim more than it checks; it only checks the mobile setting, and the fit itself was the hand check.\n\n**Decision for you:** the \"Pages\" count is all pages, so a draft page is counted under both Drafts and Pages. The ticket doesn't say whether \"pages\" means only published ones; tell me if you'd prefer that and I'll change it.\n\nAs in earlier sessions, I left `notes/usage-ledger.csv` and the new transcript out of this commit."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"end_turn","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":709,"cache_read_input_tokens":86444,"output_tokens":868,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":93},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":709,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"global","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":868,"cache_read_input_tokens":86444,"cache_creation_input_tokens":709,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":709},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"serverClassifierRequest":"e8ab7a2a-6b6e-4137-adda-cc7ee1a2bed7","apiBlockIndex":1,"requestId":"req_011CfzQHhPLRBsFZrhwC4jue","requestedModel":"claude-opus-5-5","type":"assistant","uuid":"d2992909-720c-4d02-b443-c1e42e90921f","timestamp":"2026-10-13T14:34:49.761Z","advisorModel":"claude-opus-5-5","effort":"medium","perTurnEffort":"medium","session_id":"a121db57-1bee-4dbb-8856-8744e70c4142","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/maysg/orca/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"91f90b48-e4a0-44e0-aa4c-47594fc96da9","version":"2.1.296","gitBranch":"main"}
